sentences.text: Your boat needs the right paperwork too.

A boat of five net tons or more that carries passengers for hire between American points must be documented by the Coast Guard with a coastwise endorsement, which also has requirements about where the boat was built and who owns it.
Smaller boats are registered with the state.
In Florida, charter fishing operations also need the right saltwater fishing license from the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission so your customers are covered.
Carry your credential, the boat’s documents and all required placards aboard.
